required_outcomes: Asks both contractors (Alder Compliance / Eliza Bennett and Kendall at Meadow Compliance) for their earliest start date and how long the works take, against a finish before Monday 19 May 2025.
Replies to the landlord that availability is being checked, gives him a date by which he will hear, and makes clear he still has to choose a quote before anyone is instructed.
Does not instruct or approve either contractor: the landlord has not chosen.
Puts the job on hold for the contractors' availability and the landlord's decision with a review date of no more than two or three days, given the move-in date.
acceptable_alternatives: Asking the landlord in the same message to confirm the choice in principle (for example the cheaper Alder estimate at £1,370) subject to that contractor confirming it can finish in time.
Suggesting the works be prioritised (bathroom flooring, tap, plug and shelf first; decoration last) if neither contractor can finish everything.
positive_behaviours: Points out that any work after 19 May needs the new tenant's agreement and 24 hours' written notice, and the flat must be safe and usable on move-in.
Raises the burnt bedroom carpet, which Alder's estimate leaves in place, now that a new tenant is moving in.
Notes the earlier agency emails name other properties and confirms the works are for Flat 5, 55 Lantern Quay.
red_flags: Choosing a contractor for the landlord because time is short.
Quoting a figure for Kendall that does not appear in the visible record.
prohibited_actions: Calling approve_quote or assigning a contractor before the landlord chooses.
Contacting the incoming tenant about access before she has moved in.
critical_failures: Instructing or approving either contractor without the landlord's choice.
